causalDistinctness: Behavioral cross-sectional salience weighting of prior daily returns; distinct from basis, price-volume, OI, positioning, OHLC spread, momentum, reversal, seasonality and breakout families.

externalEvidence.primary: Cai & Zhao (2024), Journal of Banking & Finance, Salience theory and cryptocurrency returns
externalEvidence.factorZoo: Mercik, Zaremba & Demir (2026), Crypto factor zoo (.Zip): salience theory value selected in the sparse equal-weight factor set and remains economically meaningful under moderate costs.
externalEvidence.conflictingScopeEvidence: Chen et al. (2022) reports salience effect concentrated in micro-cap coins; the Binance-perpetual tradable universe is therefore a deliberately harder transport test.
externalEvidence.sourceDirection: Long LOW salience-theory value (downside-salient / underpriced), short HIGH salience-theory value (upside-salient / overpriced).
externalEvidence.sourceCadence: Formation one week; hold one week; quintile sort.

method.dailyReturn: close[d]/close[d-1]-1 using fully completed UTC daily bars only
method.marketReference: equal-weight mean daily return across the timestamp-eligible universe for each formation day
method.stateRank: within each asset formation week, rank the 7 states by salience descending; k=1 is most salient; deterministic tie-break by earlier date
method.direction: LONG lowest-ST quintile; SHORT highest-ST quintile

universe.selection: same fixed 120 current-active Binance Spot-USDT + USD-M perpetual universe used in ARP24; reuse is authorized only because SAL1 is causally distinct and was prelocked after ARP24 closeout.
universe.dynamicLiquidityFilter: prior 30 fully completed UTC days mean quoteAssetVolume >= 5,000,000 USDT
universe.survivorshipRule: Any pass still requires fresh temporal validation and sealed holdout; no production inference from survivor-conditioned development alone.

dataAuthority.source: Binance official data.binance.vision USD-M monthly 1d klines ZIP + CHECKSUM

costs.chargedOn: sum absolute weekly portfolio-weight changes plus terminal liquidation
costs.note: 10bp baseline reflects altcoin perpetual execution and is stricter than the historical spot factor literature.

statistics.multiplicityPolicy: Because many prior project hypotheses have been tested, development requires P(mean>0)>=0.975 and CI95 lower >0 in addition to stability gates.

failureRule: Any development failure closes ARP25-SAL1. No sign, theta/delta, formation length, universe, liquidity, cost, cadence, or gate rescue after outcome opening. Validation and holdout remain sealed unless unchanged development passes.
